plans.note: Section 7 is captioned 'Limitations of Liability' — review cap amount, mutuality (heading suggests a Contractor-favouring construct) and carve-outs for IP infringement, confidentiality breach, and willful misconduct.

Section 7 provides 'Indemnification of Contractor' — i.e., a customer-side indemnity running the wrong way. A Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims and its own misconduct appears absent; check sec-5 reps for any residual hook and propose adding one in sec-7.
No restrictive-covenant section in the outline; scan sec-1 (purpose/scope of engagement) for any exclusivity-adjacent limits on our business. Presence rule — no comment if genuinely absent.
Check sec-1 for sole-source or 'all such services' language and sec-3 for compensation tied to exclusive engagement; otherwise absent and no action.
Pricing sits in sec-3; confirm no clause obliging us to extend best terms to Contractor. Direction rule — an MFN in our favour is welcome and should not be flagged.
No standalone personnel section listed; check sec-1 and sec-6 for hire/solicit restrictions on Clear Capital. If present, test duration, scope and general-advertising carve-out.

Section 6 (Termination) is the operative clause — confirm we may terminate on notice without penalty and that Contractor lacks a symmetric convenience right mid-term; check any early-termination or wind-down fees cross-referenced to sec-3.
Term/renewal mechanics may sit in the unnumbered/unlisted section between sec-1 and sec-3 or within sec-6; if there is no auto-renewal, treat as absent rather than deviation.
No general/miscellaneous section appears in the outline; governing law may be in an unlisted trailing provision or the preamble. Verify before recording as missing.
No miscellaneous section listed; check sec-6 for termination on change of control and the preamble for successors-and-assigns language.

Section 4 governs ownership of materials related to the Services — confirm work product and Specifications vest in Clear Capital and that no Clear Capital IP or data is assigned or licensed to Contractor.

Any licence-back or residual licence will sit in sec-4; test affiliate and contractor use rights and that the grant is not revocable at will. If ownership is outright ours, the rule may be satisfied without a separate grant.
Audit of our usage would most likely attach to compensation (sec-3) or ownership/acceptance (sec-4); likely absent in a services engagement. Do not flag audit rights running in our favour.
Check sec-3 for late-payment penalties or fixed damages payable by us and sec-7 for any stipulated-damages construct. Credits in our favour are welcome and not flagged.

Section 5 pairs Contractor warranties with a disclaimer — assess warranty duration, conformity to Specifications, and the remedy; the acceptance mechanic in sec-4 is a related cross-reference. Flag only if the disclaimer guts the warranty below the fallback.
No insurance section in the outline; if Contractor handles Clear Capital data or enters our premises, propose standard coverages, likely appended to sec-5.
Check sec-3 for minimum fees, retainer or take-or-pay hours and sec-1 for committed volumes; if a minimum exists, confirm it is exitable via sec-6.
Section 6 is the natural home for wind-down obligations and sec-4 for delivery of materials on termination; if neither provides return of our data and migration assistance, record as missing.
